findings.title: Keep the registered metric-alert handler instantiable
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of its abstract members (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data). It remains registered as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler, so accessing detector.detector_handler for a metric_alert_fire detector now raises TypeError when the model property instantiates it. Previously this handler was instantiable and returned an empty result; process_detectors will now abort rather than skip this unimplemented detector. Keep a concrete no-op handler returning {} until the stateful methods are implemented, or implement the required methods before registering it.
